meta.description:
A single open interior stretches across the grid, broken only by evenly spaced stone pillar clusters. Broad cross-routes preserve long sightlines,
  while the pillars provide landmarks and prevent the space from feeling featureless.
structural_rules: The outermost row and column form a continuous one-cell-thick boundary wall.

The
  interior is one connected walkable floor network with no enclosed pockets.
Nine 3x3 pillar blocks are arranged in a regular three-by-three landmark grid.

Four isolated single-cell
  pillars sit between the main pillar blocks.
Open lanes of at least two cells run horizontally and vertically between pillar groups.
